title: [BUG] fvm flutter / fvm dart add ~4s per invocation (git fsck --connectivity-only on cache.git)
notes: Confirmed by code inspection on v4.1.4. EnsureCacheWorkflow calls ensureBareCacheIfPresent() on every non-fork command regardless of context.gitCache, and _determineCacheState always runs git fsck --connectivity-only over the whole bare cache. The result cannot change the outcome: ready, missing, and invalid all take the same no-op branch, and the acting branches (overbroad, legacy) come from the shape check alone. Fix is to use _determineCacheShapeState at that call site; updateLocalMirror already guards the same check.
